scripts.build: npm run build:sdk && npm run build --prefix ui
scripts.test: npm run build:sdk && npm run test:server && npm run test:cli && npm run test:packages
scripts.setup: npm ci && npm ci --prefix server && npm ci --prefix ui && npm ci --prefix browser
scripts.build:sdk: npm run build --workspace=@oya-ai/browser && npm run build --workspace=@oya-ai/cli
scripts.lint: eslint . && npm run lint --prefix server && npm run lint --prefix ui && npm run lint --prefix browser
scripts.test:cli: npm run build --workspace=@oya-ai/cli && node packages/cli/tests/integration/prompt.mjs && node packages/cli/tests/integration/install.mjs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check packages/*/src packages/*/tests tooling && npm run format:check --prefix server && npm run format:check --prefix ui && npm run format:check --prefix browser
